name: the tile estimator reports the specified workspace traffic and intensity model
input: an 8 by 8 by 8 multiplication with a 4 by 4 by 4 tile
test:
cost = estimate_tiled_matmul_cost(8, 8, 8, (4, 4, 4))
assert cost['tile'] == (4, 4, 4)
assert cost['workspace_bytes'] == 192
assert cost['estimated_bytes'] == 1280
assert abs(cost['arithmetic_intensity'] - (1024.0 / 1280.0)) < 1e-12

name: the optimizer chooses the lowest traffic candidate that fits workspace
input: three legal tiles where the largest tile exceeds the cache budget
test:
chosen = choose_matrix_tiling(8, 8, 8, [(2, 2, 2), (4, 4, 4), (8, 8, 8)], 256)
assert chosen['tile'] == (4, 4, 4)
assert chosen['workspace_bytes'] == 192
assert chosen['estimated_bytes'] == 1280

name: equal traffic candidates use lexicographic tile order
input: two transposed tiles with equal modeled bytes
test:
chosen = choose_matrix_tiling(4, 4, 4, [(4, 1, 4), (1, 4, 4)], 256)
assert chosen['tile'] == (1, 4, 4)
assert chosen['estimated_bytes'] == 384
